content.rendered:
Due to the predicted inclement weather for today through the weekend our district will be releasing students at 11:00. Our planned afternoon Spelling Bee and evening Movie Night will be cancelled. And as a reminder in observance of the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday we will not have school on Monday.

Here is the latest Middleton Weekly.
